metadata.label: Shape model
metadata.coverage: Hubble photometry gives an effective radius of 1.3 ± 0.2 km, assuming V-band geometric albedo 0.04, and brightness changes of at least 0.8 mag imply a sky-plane axis ratio of 2:1 or more. No shape model, pole or period was published. This display is a prolate ellipsoid at exactly the minimum 2:1 ratio, sized so the geometric mean of its largest and smallest cross-sections equals π × (1.3 km)²: full axes 4.37 × 2.19 × 2.19 km. A longer body, another albedo or a different shape would change it. Arbitrary display pole and meridian. No rotation pole or phase has been measured. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
